'''Giant Banyan''' is an area of {{Location|Dim Forest}}. Some time prior to the game's events, the entire region was contaminated by toxic spores that caused damage to any who inhaled it. Although Resonators had a stronger resistance, prolonged exposure would cause serious health risks.<ref>[[Exploration Quest]]: [[When the Forest is No Longer Dim]]</ref>

Due to these spores, players can only explore the area for a brief period before being automatically teleported away. This effect will disappear upon completion of [[When the Forest is No Longer Dim]].

One piece of [[Dim Forest Data]] can be found in this area, near the [[Resonance Beacon]] north of the tree.
